notes.title: ENDLESS RPG v1.000!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35121121/97d6278770aa8fbb5b8b1b6243dbc87adca4611c.png

Hello everybody! How are you today? This is it! Endless RPG come to an end of its development with this update! Just as planned and promissed, all features are there. Me and my brother would like to thank each and everyone of you that helped us along the way. Your feedback were invaluable to us. We tried to make things that you suggested and we are sorry for things that we couldn't change.

I will still maintain and correct any bugs that pops up and respond the to questions on the discussion board. I hope you have fun with the game, it's more than 20h (possibily 40h) hours long and it never really ends as you could move your group from a world to another or create another party entirely. =]

These are the features of this version:

The Root of All Evil: a quest that spawns everytime you destroy an Evil Center or an Evil Agent
Building Quest: you can now give money to a Town for it to build structures
Save System: a save system that is more inline with other mainstream games
Bug Bash:

Try Save routine, that prevents save files corruption
Grow Bushes skill on top of rocks
Crash on Debug when flee combat
MultiStrike not causing Flank

notes.title: Endless RPG Almost Done
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35121121/859020f029fcc0429039fadb09565e4a05b2ffff.png

Hello everybody! How are you? As December approaches I am happy to announce that we are getting to the end phase of Endless RPG. There are 2 features left:

 The Building Quest: that allows the player to help a town to construct new buildings;
 The Root of All Evil: a quest line that will spawn from Evil Centers. When completed that kind of Evil Center will not pop up anymore;


I plan to deliver on early December and then move on to new projects. I will, for sure, still address bugs and answer this forum.

It’s been a pleasure to talk to everyone here, thank you so very much for your support. I tried my best to keep up with your expectations and avoid over promising (even if that meant to lose sales). I hope I could achieve that and give you a simple game that is just fun. =]

Stay tuned on the next upcoming update!


Cheers!
Kezarus

They will appear on the map and spread chaos in the world. Shrinking villages, spreading lies, razing every building and making a never ending night. Only your team will be able to defeat them.
